ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "IAN HOBSON PIANO MASTERCLASS." This course is open to piano performance majors who would like to participate in a half-hour piano masterclass with Ian Hobson. The five fall 2022 dates are (1) Tuesday, September 13 and Tuesday, October 18 from 3:00-5:00 pm in Smith Recithal Hall; and (2) Thursday, September 15; Thursday, October 20; and Thursday, November 20 from 9:00-11:00 am in Smith Recital Hall. Please email Prof. Hobson to inquire about masterclass information (ihobson@illinois.edu). Tuesday, November 8, 3:00pm-5:00pm SMR Thursday, November 20, 9:00am-11:00am SMH
